title: The sequencer exposure ledger is carried as one file per row

needles: two branches adding different rows merge without conflict
control: the same two rows appended to one document conflicted
a row file named for a different row was rejected

installed_sdk.rationale: The ledger and its checker are repository governance artifacts. No installed header, target, or exported symbol changes; the offline writer-profile sources the gate reads are untouched.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, or handler is added or changed. The checker is a repository gate invoked by the pre-push hook and CI, not a shipped command.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition or handler is added or changed. Nothing in tools/mcp reads the ledger.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation, executor binding, or profile policy changes. The ledger records exposure; it is not itself reachable from a live product control.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: docs/status/agent-capabilities.json is unchanged. Changing where the ledger stores its rows publishes no design-time capability.
